propositions: Directory creation followed by first event write has an unsafe window where interruption leaves an empty ticket directory fsck reports as MISSING_CREATE or FOREIGN_STORE_PATH
The fix stages directory and CREATE event together in a dot-prefixed temporary path, then publishes them atomically via os.rename under the write lock
Staging paths follow naming convention <tracker>/.tmp-newticket-<pid>-<uuid4hex> which makes them invisible to existing fsck scanners without code changes
Stale staging directories owned by dead processes are swept on writer start using process stamp metadata, respecting the boundary that writer-side cleanup never touches committed ticket directories

All dir-then-file sites in the store write path are either converted to use StagedEvent or explicitly exempted: batch_stage_and_commit, inbound_translate._write_event_file, and dispatch_one BRIDGE_ALERT emission are converted; lock.py, hlc.py, fsck_repair.py, and config writers are exempt
Lock discipline and event visibility semantics are unchanged: events remain invisible until under the write lock and after rebase guard and under_lock_check pass
